features.label: One size ankle stabilizer
features.text: Comes in one universal size with no measuring needed, choose right or left.

features.label: L-shell talus control
features.text: Semi-rigid shell sits in front of the talus bone to help prevent talar shift and lateral rolling.

features.label: Lateral sprain protection
features.text: Stabilizes the ankle against rolling while allowing a natural heel-to-toe walking motion.

features.label: Optional plantar pad
features.text: Repositionable pad under the foot stimulates the dorsiflexor muscles for added active stabilization.

features.label: Low-profile shoe fit
features.text: Slim design fits inside sports and business shoes for wear at work or practice.

features.label: Soft microfiber cushioning
features.text: Padded microfiber cushion lines the shell to reduce pressure and keep you comfortable.

features.label: Secure closure
features.text: Hook-and-loop straps cross the instep and wrap behind the Achilles tendon to hold the shell firmly in place.

features.label: Pdac approved l1902
features.text: Ankle orthosis, ankle gauntlet or similar, with or without joints, prefabricated, off-the-shelf.

indications: Non-surgical treatment of sprains and ruptured ligaments
Acute and chronic capsular ligament instability
Post-operative rehabilitation and protection after ligament suture or reconstruction
measurement: One size fits all. No measurement needed. Choose Right or Left to match the ankle that needs support. Wear a sock or hosiery under the orthosis. The low-profile shell fits inside most sports and business shoes. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee.
